title: Crestline Companion Phone Booking Fee Refunds on Crestline Cancellations: Desk Reference
content:
A voluntary cancellation never returns a phone booking fee, but when Crestline cancels a companion booking the phone booking fee paid on it is refunded by the companion desk in one refund entry that names that phone booking fee charge. This applies on every product of Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes.

| Who cancelled the companion booking | Phone booking fee paid on it |
|---|---|
| the holder (voluntary cancellation) | never returned |
| Crestline | refunded by the companion desk in one refund entry naming that phone booking fee charge |

## Capability

`refund_companion_phone_booking_fee_90a9c390` refunds to the holder the phone booking fee of a companion booking on a certificate or pass. One call records one refund of component phone booking fee, dated today, on that certificate's or pass's charge history, naming the phone booking fee charge it refunds and carrying that charge's companion ticket number; the holder's companion charges fall by the amount refunded, and the holder sees the refund on the certificate or pass.

## How it is invoked

Agent-side: the agent unlocks `refund_companion_phone_booking_fee_90a9c390` and calls it.

## Parameters

- `companion_id` — reference number of the companion certificate or pass record the refund is recorded on, as returned by the companion certificate and pass lookup.
- `reversed_entry_id` — reference number of the phone booking fee charge entry being refunded, as returned by the companion trip and charge history lookup.
- `amount` — the phone booking fee amount refunded, in USD, a decimal number rounded to 2 decimal places (cents), rounding half up; never negative.

## Return

A receipt with `refund_entry_id` (reference of the new refund), `companion_id`, `refunded_charge_entry_id` (the charge refunded), `charge_component` (always `phone_booking_fee`), `amount_usd` (USD, 2 decimal places), `entry_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, today's business date) and `status` (`refund_recorded` when the refund is on file). No error receipt is defined.
